g.text: Add or replace paths in an existing backup by creating an update.
Load an existing backup folder or scanned pages, unlock the backup, and choose
the files or folders to add. For scans, confirm you loaded the latest version
or enter the fingerprint printed on the version you trust as latest.
From a backup folder, Ethernity appends update documents without replacing
existing documents. From scans, it writes separate update documents to an
A selected path replaces the current content at that path. Omitted paths
